notes: An initial parallel browser run had one crashed target; final sequential pose run passed. No root cause is asserted for that process crash.

The original muzzle observer required the exact one-tick active frame. Real input was accepted, but the renderer could skip that tick; the corrected passive observer records the actual outgoing projectile and checks displacement against elapsed simulation ticks. Final captures happened one tick after emission for all four cases.

The initial Lying Figure story harness incorrectly expected a launch despite an absent exact opponent. The final explicit blocker contract verifies refusal and leaves the route and combat admission unchanged.
